ns2:course.label: Preparation for Auditions
ns2:course.description: Each actor, through extensive research, prepares a portfolio of audition pieces for the opportunities imminent before and after graduation for resident companies, commercial productions, and film, or professional graduate schools. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. Prerequisite: THEA 375, THEA 376, THEA 377, THEA 378.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to BFA:Theatre: Acting -UIUC.
